job_function: collateral management / margin operations analyst (regulatory IM segregation)
control_point: Regulatory initial margin is calculated, posted to a segregated custodian and its segregation evidenced; governed by collateral operations with counterparty credit risk sign-off.

consequence_anchor.public_source: CFTC and EU uncleared margin rules: published supervisory fines and remediation orders for IM segregation and posting failures
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: qualitative: enforcement notices describe penalties scaling with duration and materiality; no fixed public tariff

commonality_rationale: Every in-scope derivatives counterparty under UMR must post initial margin with a segregated custodian and evidence segregation; EMIR Art. 11(3) and CFTC Subpart I apply market-wide, and public enforcement records document failures.
